The '''[[Eredivisie|Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1929–1930''' was contested by 50 teams participating in five divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of the eastern, northern, southern and two western football divisions of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Go Ahead Eagles|Go Ahead]] won this year's championship by beating [[AFC Ajax]], [[Velocitas 1897]], [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]] and [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]].

==New entrants==
'''Eerste Klasse East:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[FC Zwolle|PEC Zwolle]]
'''Eerste Klasse North:'''
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[LAC Frisia 1883]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-I:'''
*Moving in from West-II: [[DFC (football club)|DFC]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[SBV Excelsior]] and [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[HFC Haarlem]]
'''Eerste Klasse West-II:'''
*Moving in from West-I: [[Hermes DVS]], [[Koninklijke HFC]], [[Telstar (football club)|Stormvogels]] and [[VUC (football club)|VUC]]
